source_evidence: Player exact 'yes this is unfinished business' authorizes Desen's offered authorized financial review, not an expedition or spending. Source-pinned prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4; dm-ferry-i.md @8e5df88d508d558ed0907593bb84c8c65a6741ea; archive/history-day-165.md and Cirren inventory four-original Watch receipt. G1 actual account4-C control and seven convicted killings, independent good-faith boatyard and distinction between pre-death payment and subsequent diversion; G2 concrete payee/yard and voluntary follow-up, no obligatory branch; G3 routine authorized record disclosure, no RNG necessary, new tactical packet required only on actual dangerous approach. New authorized comparison established in play; not an alleged discovery in V's earlier completed search. No new amount, exact historic calendar date, current financial claim or hidden culprit asserted. Desen retains originals; V has learned the lead, no receipt taken. D325~17:25 at the Western District Watch annex in Orsaven, after a visit to Sgt Rill Desen; V accepted both negotiated commissions. Lark Street Letter Writer's confirmed quillwright receives140gp deposit for one Hadiya's Handy Quill (Saddlebag Book Two p97, uncommon attunement), total420gp, remaining280gp on completed delivery. Two Spindles Clothiers' confirmed needlecraft specialist receives120gp deposit for one set Weaving Wasp Needles (Saddlebag Book Two p187, uncommon), total360gp, remaining240gp upon completed delivery. Separate makers' single commission slots now committed, work starts D325, target D353 after28 campaign days. Expected ready for local collection in Orsaven; actual completion/handover required; no onward shipment or transport fee arranged. V pays260gp once, purse2311gp8sp6cp→2051gp8sp6cp, remaining contractual balances520gp not yet paid or a protected reserve. Existing D216-ORSAVEN-HADIYA-QUILL-INQUIRY-001 and D216-ORSAVEN-WASP-NEEDLES-INQUIRY-001 become accepted orders; no item yet in party custody/attuned. Serpent Dart still no supplier. Prior visits to Pellin/Maud/Sabine completed. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attacks+9, greataxe unchanged. Mara, coach and four horses healthy, stabled at Copper Hart. Rations21/feed28, LR5/6, D325 overnight not yet booked or rested. Crown sealed invitation and credentials undelivered, frontier commission300+1300, Coris300/800 contingent, Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed, Kestrel custody unchanged. V dice delegated. Desen confirms from public court disposition: Quenwood sentenced to life imprisonment with court-ordered restitution from identified assets; appeal has been heard, conviction and sentence upheld (genuine d20 13; predeclared 1–3 limited procedural remand, 4–20 upheld). Assets frozen, no distribution yet (genuine d20 4; predeclared 1–5 freeze/no distribution, 6–15 partial, 16–20 verified liquid assets distributed). This is newly adjudicated independent offscreen progress over 120 elapsed days since D205 conviction, not an earlier recovered ruling. Exact dates, sums, intermediary culpability and additional financial claims not established. No wider organization found by this verdict; no release, new trial, or fresh protective duty. Desen can explain the available public disposition and permits a separate inquiry into authorized financial evidence if V chooses; no documents or new quest accepted or handed over. Cirren is relieved by the upheld conviction and concerned about beneficiaries awaiting compensation. V has made no new payment, speech, feature use or further commitment. V expressly accepts examination of the financial trail. Desen shows the four already receipted Crownward financial originals (Watch custody since165) alongside an authorized clearing-office comparison identifying a distinct pre-death payment from beneficiary account4-C to a local shipwright for an outstanding two-ferry-hull installment. Later post-funeral false allowance withdrawals into4-C are a separate series, not double-counted as the original boat payment. The clearing entry identifies the actual payee/yard; yard receipted bill and guarantee remain with the good-faith shipwright, not inspected yet. Desen knows the old disbursement and that the relevant ferry operation is still trading from public local records, but cannot establish ongoing Quenwood share, current proceeds, third-party culpability or recoverable amount without new evidence. He permits a voluntary interview with the identified yard proprietor and ordinary directions to the boatyard on the city's main commercial river; no search warrant, seizure right, new fee, reward, document custody transfer or compulsory prosecution. Cirren wants actual compensation for families and offers to examine any voluntarily shown yard documents. Quest The Ferrymen's Share financial-trail inquiry is introduced/accepted to the extent of reviewing the lead; no boatyard visit, sailing, independent hazard or further branch activated, no hidden wider syndicate fact revealed. Await V choice to visit yard tomorrow during working hours, seek other information, or continue other commitments.
